RASOUL ANNOUNCES PREPARATIONS TO FORM EXPLORATORY COMMITTEE FOR CONGRESS As Donald Trump attacks our democracy, this moment requires leaders who will fight for Medicare for All, a Green New Deal, and an end to the genocide in Gaza. I am preparing paperwork for an exploratory committee to run for Congress. As a Palestinian-American who has represented Appalachia for over a decade, I have spent my career standing up to special interests who have rigged the system against Virginia's working families. Our region deserves a fighter who will never back down in the face of injustice at home and abroad, and will tackle the affordability crisis that we all face. I look forward to exploring the best path to serve our community as the stakes rise higher by the day. | ~~ | ACA PREMIUM HIKES LOOMING The US Senate planes to vote on two health care related bills today in light of the ACA subsides set to expire for more than 20 million Americans at the end of the year. Rep. Adelita Grijalva was attacked for defending her community.

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/121078335/588283507/1328794144?refcode=ea.f756b02d-b3d6-f011-8195-000d3a1d58aa&ms=ea.f756b02d-b3d6-f011-8195-000d3a1d58aa&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImY3NTZiMDJkLWIzZDYtZjAxMS04MTk1LTAwMGQzYTFkNThhYSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=5cJK1khzjehHC2GynJYtX19R7JwBtKpy5CNdVSh75Is=&emci=d460178b-abd6-f011-8195-000d3a1d58aa&emdi=f756b02d-b3d6-f011-8195-000d3a1d58aa&ceid=4823105)

Last Friday, our JanePAC climate champion from Arizona, Congresswoman Adelita Grijalva, was pepper-sprayed by masked ICE agents in Tucson. Her “crime”? Asking questions and standing up for her community. **We REFUSE to stay silent about this.** [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/121078337/588283516/2105508926?refcode=ea.f756b02d-b3d6-f011-8195-000d3a1d58aa&ms=ea.f756b02d-b3d6-f011-8195-000d3a1d58aa&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImY3NTZiMDJkLWIzZDYtZjAxMS04MTk1LTAwMGQzYTFkNThhYSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=5cJK1khzjehHC2GynJYtX19R7JwBtKpy5CNdVSh75Is=) Adelita was on her way to lunch at a local mom-and-pop shop in her district when she learned ICE was conducting a raid. She identified herself as a Member of Congress and demanded more information – the kind any elected official should ask when their constituents may be at risk. _**ICE pushed her aside and pepper-sprayed her.**_ Think about that for a moment. If federal agents are brazen enough to attack a sitting Member of Congress in broad daylight, in her own district, in front of her own community, imagine what happens to the people with no title, no camera, and no protection? When JanePAC endorsed Adelita Grijalva during her contested primary, we knew that she was going to be a fierce climate justice champion who was not afraid to speak truth to power. The first bill Adelita introduced when she was FINALLY sworn in is to protect the sacred Oak Flat from a foreign mining company — a cultural and religious site of critical importance to Tribal communities. And last week, she stood toe to toe with the Trump Administration and even put her own safety on the line for others. **This is exactly why we work to elect leaders like Adelita.** Leaders who will call out Trump’s authoritarian agenda, stand up to MAGA Republicans like Speaker Mike Johnson, and fight like hell for their communities. Adelita isn't backing down. Neither are we. This fight is far from over. Adelita Grijalva was attacked for defending her community. | Last Friday, our JanePAC climate champion from Arizona, Congresswoman Adelita Grijalva, was pepper-sprayed by masked ICE agents in Tucson. Her “crime”? Asking questions and standing up for her community. We REFUSE to stay silent about this. = Adelita was on her way to lunch at a local mom-and-pop shop in her district when she learned ICE was conducting a raid. She identified herself as a Member of Congress and demanded more information – the kind any elected official should ask when their constituents may be at risk. ICE pushed her aside and pepper-sprayed her. Think about that for a moment. If federal agents are brazen enough to attack a sitting Member of Congress in broad daylight, in her own district, in front of her own community, imagine what happens to the people with no title, no camera, and no protection? When JanePAC endorsed Adelita Grijalva during her contested primary, we knew that she was going to be a fierce climate justice champion who was not afraid to speak truth to power. The first bill Adelita introduced when she was FINALLY sworn in is to protect the sacred Oak Flat from a foreign mining company — a cultural and religious site of critical importance to Tribal communities. And last week, she stood toe to toe with the Trump Administration and even put her own safety on the line for others. This is exactly why we work to elect leaders like Adelita. Leaders who will call out Trump’s authoritarian agenda, stand up to MAGA Republicans like Speaker Mike Johnson, and fight like hell for their communities. Adelita isn't backing down. Neither are we. This fight is far from over. subject: From Jerusalem To DC - The Last 2 Weeks Have Been Impactful
body:
The last 2 weeks I have been away from home but have been greatly impacted. Several months ago, I was asked to help recruit Pastors from our pastoral
| | |
---
The last 2 weeks I have been away from home but have been _greatly impacted_. Several months ago, I was asked to help recruit Pastors from our pastoral network to attend a historic gathering of over **1000 Pastors in Israel**. We successfully recruited many Pastors who took the 6000 mile trip to Israel and it was amazing; some would say life-changing. But the trip proved all the more of the spiritual battle that we are in because of the CRAZY attacks online from _"Christian Influencers"_ who are flabbergasted that American Christian Pastors would dare visit the **Holy Land** that our brothers and sisters in Christ have made pilgrimage to for the last 2000 years (online _"Christian Influencers"_ might be some of the dumbest people on the planet...). After coming back from **Israel** , I had several meetings in **DC** and at the **White House** regarding this subject and much more that our Nation is facing. We are getting ready to roll out something **very significant** and I am asking that you would pray for me as this new adventure is being planned and organized and set to be announced here soon. Great things are taking place but the war is far from being won. Continue to pray for **America** , Israel and the advancement of the Kingdom here on earth as it already is in Heaven. Thank you, Pastor Jackson Lahmeyer

| | Trump wants to go to war against Venezuela. **_I want to stop him._** That's why I introduced legislation with Senator Tim Kaine to block any federal funds from being used to wage an unauthorized war against Venezuela. The heart of our Constitution is the separation of powers, and the Founders were crystal clear that decisions of war rest with Congress, the representatives of the people. President Trump has neither a Congressional declaration of war nor an authorization of war, but he is taking America to war anyway. He has directed a massive buildup of firepower off Venezuela's shore, blown up a couple of dozen boats with their occupants, ordered a shutdown of Venezuelan airspace, and promised that land strikes are to come. **He is trampling on the law and the Constitution.** If he wants to go to war, he needs to come to Congress and ask for authorization. **I will vote HELL NO!** Did we learn nothing from the wars in Iraq and Afghanistan? Thousands of American sons and daughters killed, tens of thousands seriously injured, and trillions of dollars wasted. I will keep fighting this insanity, and I hope you'll stand with me. I want to stop him. That's why I introduced legislation with Senator Tim Kaine to block any federal funds from being used to wage an unauthorized war against Venezuela. The heart of our Constitution is the separation of powers, and the Founders were crystal clear that decisions of war rest with Congress, the representatives of the people. President Trump has neither a Congressional declaration of war nor an authorization of war, but he is taking America to war anyway. He has directed a massive buildup of firepower off Venezuela's shore, blown up a couple of dozen boats with their occupants, ordered a shutdown of Venezuelan airspace, and promised that land strikes are to come. He is trampling on the law and the Constitution. If he wants to go to war, he needs to come to Congress and ask for authorization. I will vote HELL NO! Did we learn nothing from the wars in Iraq and Afghanistan? Thousands of American sons and daughters killed, tens of thousands seriously injured, and trillions of dollars wasted. I will keep fighting this insanity, and I hope you'll stand with me. Onward! | Dear Fellow American,

I'm doing something I don't normally do - **sharing an excerpt from an internal memo sent to me by our Senior Attorney Bob Popper** in response to increasingly dangerous threats to the integrity of our elections.
Bob joined us in 2013 after leaving the US Department of Justice where he served as Deputy Chief of the Voting Rights Section.
He is one of America's top election law experts and he now heads up our election law legal team.
Like most followers of Judicial Watch's work, I expect Election Integrity matters a great deal to you, so I thought you would be interested to read his message to me first-hand.

**__MEMORANDUM__** _
To: Tom Fitton
From: Bob Popper, Senior Attorney and Election Law Initiative Director
Date: December 1, 2025
Re: Legal Battle Plan for Fair and Honest Elections in 2026 and Beyond_
_I 'm looking at the election law battles now in progress across the country, and **I 'm seeing more than 200 active cases** underway in state and federal courts. To me, it's clear _radical leftist groups and their political operatives are pushing harder than ever to alter US election procedures in advance of the 2026 congressional midterm elections_. _
_Their intentions are also clear: To undermine and/or demolish any legal safeguard designed to ensure fair and honest elections._
_Especially at the state level. Many of the parade of bad federal bills they introduced in Congress during the Biden years, but couldn 't get through the Senate, are resurfacing as laws or proposed laws in some states...including dangerous provisions like these:_

* _Making permanent COVID-related accommodations like unsecured mass balloting and ballot harvesting_
* _Failing to comply with federal law that requires states to take reasonable steps to keep their voter rolls clean_
* _Even supporting new initiatives to allow NON-CITIZENS to vote._
_I believe 2026 could be decisive in determining if fair and honest elections persevere in America, or whether the Left will succeed in so corrupting our electoral processes that they will destroy public faith in them. I certainly hope not._
__I ask that as we help educate Americans in the months ahead, please impress upon our supporters the vital nature of our work fighting for fair and clean elections in courtrooms__ _._

Bob leads our Election Law team of attorneys (along with over a dozen investigators) who together make Judicial Watch the most effective independent conservative litigator in the ongoing battles to keep American elections honest.
| [ CONTRIBUTE TO FIGHT FOR ELECTION INTEGRITY ](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=78253&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)
---

Since starting our election integrity program, Judicial Watch's honest elections legal team has filed federal lawsuits against nearly 20 states.

And we have filed suits and given notice to many other states breaking federal law by not cleaning their voter rolls, which has led to **more than 5 million ineligible names being removed**.

Just this year, Bob's team has also presented oral arguments and secured approval for case review, respectively, in two Election Integrity cases before the **United States Supreme Court**.

Because of our success, **I firmly believe the Left will stop at nothing** to corrupt our elections in an effort to reclaim power in 2026 and beyond.

That's why we have set an ambitious goal of raising $9.6 million dollars more by December 31.

_We must fill our war chest to fight back_ , and I would like to ask you to contribute.

_[Can you make a generous, tax-deductible gift today to help ensure our Election Law team stays on track through year-end and begins 2026 strong](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=78253&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)_?

[ FUEL JUDICIAL WATCH'S ELECTION LAW TEAM FOR 2026 ](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=78253&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)
---

You joining Judicial Watch as a financial supporter will provide the resources needed to keep America's most effective election integrity unit fighting, and to support all our work fighting government corruption.

Thank you for reading Bob's memo, and for considering a first-time gift to Judicial Watch.

Sincerely,

Tom Fitton
President, Judicial Watch

P.S. I cannot overstate the importance of your decision to join our work. The Left is boosting efforts to overturn state election safeguards, enable non-citizens to vote, and steal elections in 2026. Judicial Watch is the one organization in America with the track record to counter them, so _[I deeply hope you will join with us today by making a first time, tax-deductible contribution](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=78253&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)_.

body:
| | |
---
| | Hi Peter,

My name is Lauren Toncich -- and for the past seven years, I've helped lead the team behind the curtain at every Turning Point USA event.

Making sure the lights hit at the right moment, the music is pumping through the crowd, and tens of thousands of people walk into something unforgettable.

I've never emailed you directly before.

But if you've ever seen the opening night of AmericaFest... felt the electricity of a Student Action Summit crowd... or watched one of our massive rallies ignite a room...

Then you've witnessed the kind of energy Charlie dreamed of -- brought to life by our incredible events team.
---
[](https://links.iterable.com/s/c/jSIF90YORfCY-sMMTRRkFk0aWfRSdACW_twyIycMarMcwj7wSzl8bsIemEwQ7sq-00bG1u1SIChv3BIxvIY7OHZl4yWBWIa5mxqEkG2cz_qmo33z7TnvEX4iXuUuZrW3c5fSTHE9rECzrwdxGV4asvegYJlh4Adim8VydYyHK6KpGWkxTe64PC1O1PHfqE81Xhbl08yWxTka5tphsdRSwjBrRzihmJObu8DgXX0tLpADL8rJBawMVOg70AHB5qoIiQUF_EyfDr2BsEXPf7T1VKQWoOaUsh3xCLjyKZnqh_1sR6qlj25CHnOyvnHmXFRJDKNZijSdJ-u3RYkid82DAoiW8Y5NkFIG_VR_NFNJMPKOQQ1RlcDuYnRO7yppP7RY_DqWHouwnx2ZCSSnOr88NPQMRqJbHuu_8-eVAizAQPjN4sunK6ElIiyqDEw28u1muWxvzXgNQud8ZG_Jlflsfu5i3xVeYLtMWllVE5f4NV6j1-8zjxCK5QKqhli0pa1DQKuBmqZgBntYUagr_s9MbQ3FiMHf6Ug7vOPyVl1ICmUyfaY4kYdx5f_9XWxZB-njwAwHUPsvt6nWGS2LVimFhEXOkvk8xk19wN58vulP1KwQhSsiF-2ERFvH0dKkAJezjdgHBXwdVfQGOkQ5t_ci7-QeZuQRrRwf34wsQQ_fLcw0Gh66dDV0Go66Fdue7z7dRjJmW469UaY9nkeyO6FJ7-GIpBQoBzKPB7H6WJmTOgANLAspfyWRefWQVFTuVa2V4uYS4m2fLPFpGuqt_5oSZLhioFPsNlcqqL1dtQR8VhSl54zQ-aE9u_pT98nG1feM2Qme9zRC7LGR1pzZCKrrnHwD6U7GbJsdKc5UWUO6cFgCIyzubvSp8bd4hQ8-j88/vBOsxSGBfi5CuA9w_Nu7Gw6JLahNDjE3/15)

_Above: That 's me with Charlie, backstage at last year's AmFest making sure every detail was perfect before showtime. _
---
At the heart of every single Turning Point event is this one truth: _Young Americans deserve a stage worthy of the fight they 're in. _

**And AmericaFest -- especially this year -- is our most important stage of all. **

**This December 18 -21 in Phoenix, thousands of students will walk into the most powerful conservative gathering in America. **

It will be our first AmFest without Charlie.

This is the stage he built -- with vision, grit, and sky-high standards.

Charlie poured everything into these events, because he believed students deserved more than beige ballrooms and lazy lectures.

He believed they needed to _FEEL_ the mission -- That they were part of something unstoppable... something big enough to change the world.

Backstage, I can still hear him directing the show: _" Louder music... more sparks... bigger energy... how full are we looking?" _

Not because he wanted flash for the sake of flash...

But because he knew energy moves people. Environments shape conviction.

_And atmosphere matters when you 're calling students into the fight of their lives. _
---
[](https://links.iterable.com/s/c/g0TvGonIY9EtHQe5S9XTzEp_VadTGb3EbraOpuJGZZuvCSxoLGLt9BVFw7z_Xi9ATQ1SIJ62Kjt7qcc0EYfvk7UXKBEzzx3t8oWrXrFVpHH8KwArYJmXjQEJpnB9J2laFw-TSRBjHlPwG5Xrrcpw-Yv3kTwWF3OIA2aYhbbQiBIE7ZlmAaHCkdFPUUAhVBkLujKqm9t2e9-3QlPiU3oai10au0o4T1_0Dr9Qocyns6xhYCRNDMrOpp-Q2tV-mE6ZAExOz1a47FGwEDCURXBRKicciy4jaIC1GpSD6NpIxyKEYROjL39I5qLvVgaNlLqAbeDF80gwpd23USEqe_2VfFqrdoXvPfKvtcbM33uDuAgS0xKnp-mOxrUSQYSTU0FHCpM4y9h4pX6nb7R2gADI-fCn64zeUXUWczrjr-Bpef_wR00QPXTO3iMzDAAQFzPMCyb8NVK2lnzLMFgXqvaWtF8MMxM_IXhanyElYcfs6dh2WdWBEvWUfCldFYkj2qwuYb8e4G0DB6Wpei7Tiw6Tr0wowZu4rtFVoJnbEthMenTLo1yETPJaS4ezY2Xqebn2yIPf_wT8tHaPCteW5r1HUM-YYYgHWjR21X312J6HrrdBT-w089cexTfjKspLi3_ZiMC1noctEcAPQiwQg9mEAgjSXhYwpBxoBYZXG4ubb7eOhDLtCf2k0Sh-1578ed70niLQs9a-bg6sjb7lf6UGj0LOLUdZbDBvcZMehBvoW5o1BkBeeFlxZJbTRW0JZyOuzuqGlcsYaRdvTjMEyPzs0imkmTa_Skghmea2Dj4nmUYYGyNpV4jPZUzQxD9wEFbjzFEt16PYiuWp3T6SmXwu2OFD0wwC6Qw8c2w5hk1xcK4DA7lFO1ShTefYTnTvEl8/ytjIM3VmCc2RDy5o9qEqCWnX0WC2SbnO/15)
---
This year's AmFest?

_I 've never seen more students eager to be part of it. _

**Nearly 6,000 are registered. Another 2,200 are on the waitlist. **

**And we only have a few days left to get them in. **

Peter, these students aren't looking for entertainment...

They're looking for courage, purpose, and a movement to belong to.

They're stepping onto hostile campuses. They're getting flak from Leftist professors.

Many are leading Turning Point chapters in places where they're told to sit down, shut up -- or worse.

**They want to stand for America... _They just need a chance to stand with others who will, too. _**

And when they get to AmFest, it's not just the main stage that changes their lives.

Behind the lights and cameras, they sit in smaller breakout rooms -- face-to-face with staff and speakers who show them exactly how to lead.
---
[](https://links.iterable.com/s/c/QyWDC_KxBdE7ttiOh54MCM2an3FwaYGsowi6kove7bD-NQCmWs1Lt_LXDihJY0sNrnjVaftgTx8D6IXDnKXdf13YdU3LLr61d3p33u8rgGH9GfodaJSpOBm1n76PZCKVET14552Hm2LJjedIcFKjmdVGV9pw0SC9oDwP4TlC5tLiImX8_iJ14vMgY9tjfV1I0AkZfraxN02AIrlp39dkatHMZ2_BEYA1JbmubZk0jYqRTA2RMmGMor3P9enMiKUEaO4QJAM0xpFyhHu2DoPJRAmpWLJ1ErzoJMZB4pv-PU0u91VHnQTcaxme6YOoxutjcvWH89k39sc9qRGI0_ULNukk9yl0YAK1lwAg0BHtY34Gh0FPDg4t3jhEsSB5pin87GVjY9jlgrtSIFToknaunSm4mxzszpiL_diocpAfG-MvBfVfXlcgrCwKfbfC1rg4OAaWZoXndXVJx0ff78kIgZoMXsSA44Lu8xh-RFE84TjhomYY_tDFfhW7d24XTnIvitXXr0VPJFgYhm_Qu9lcgxuiYYWLhNnnrnLIQ3UYaIe8MsgWnN6bTbiB1oKnjIt1k_FnYWjzs8a-SqXCsaGfwyabhZNqWVCyo8lycfbt9zCB-dBMB3mGTig-u7KSjCx-_MDLb-qZ4xb2eE73r_Kb4nIQ-XkL20_nK7E6C25TQ4PJX7OeIMWn3jsJ3kEbI6PZSMGhwgyhSHjMkj6cnJ3cxqNcrR54QTWceemnn08BpbUyviER7bQVWb5WxzMldfpBcrp9GUJnaaczIXB-Y9_zvPfr4IljbEotgsjxfXT2aGtAC5ZUEl_Hc0YOdKwfPP8MzYATQjsoGbPD3TMC3tTAYT3Gl-8bjFqInS6OkK8SmY6v0cbDeOcgpxrCgbN4c1w/nEbaiL9N9oRrb67EiVYg1yie2_8f7RjD/15)

They learn how to organize. How to launch and grow chapters. How to push back against the Left -- strategically and fearlessly.

They're trained to fight -- and win.

Because inspiration is just the beginning. We want every student walking out of AmFest equipped for the battlefield they're stepping into.

**Peter, that 's where you can make a difference. **

**Every $50 you give today helps sponsor a student to attend AmericaFest. And today, your gift will be MATCHED -- dollar-for-dollar. **

That means:

🔥 $50 sends TWO students
🔥 $100 sends FOUR
🔥 $250 sends EIGHT, and more.

**[You can be the reason a future leader walks into AmFest this December — instead of staying home wondering if they’re alone in this fight.](https://links.iterable.com/s/c/fwx_lTVmA0TVdeE7mUtfcbCMbiwHRsxQccoZLRJqE-e68a6CYrqJcmBuPufMxBDSKdiPLLwaIhPVDTlhZIJi-WMiJb1kqTiYjfb7873R6RW4kR2WgnarAcaLBrEQJDcrdHFw4npewj83b2oHrRQdMRAFYllrpc08Y5ygFUz1lfFiNLqHbnJYTh0x3yJl5uGD2T-pBaevvexgMOMVAE0pzBrOUqIflQIJ-uD0xlR3b2BSEPHAbZ-r720xlI2PItVYhnUT7f4ucKqAopn1iuH51yQk8o68P9FgVODK0oogZzqSLPHcHK3StYqM2vtZCN4nilG2QHIJt238AErlyQ3HK-JjRUJOEnGYbvXmjEou7LOmQU_btUdnVJy_Bcp2tNMiKEaN8_thuLhaj-NOMXZeJo3dHy7K9HbeK9cO7v1SRhciRu0lbhpr6h8p-3WmCFedhR7U6ep7_EyPntgnda_OtAa1Dwrnbe_XuW0p5SI0f23sux18PHQ08INn6smxpTDJlLQFDj8oD6kuEEdulSsm3ZiyqVLbVbEVkaQVQBRloFzrQAvwQAhz0SBYXO2V_LbsiOjjpS59kdvYMXi19uidRQ4jKtCiPHqhqgjn0llFeA1c2HX8OCfilx8Heojg5WMJ71d5HbnbV9TVAaIdBRQJMwVaNEBlCKs0ZbVS2Z1f9I5lEO8TcvnZ1nDHCaQ2AQhtDV9gIvp77BLlfElzKe7fV-6B7mm-6LgkvDK1zSfjHdyc2LczmzSto-puAK3YGRd7UlyYq6QwVzgg6eEDKJGsRQTpCpZKS-NXAuxzNS3nLbdclzW0-sEu3PHH4RaM9bfbpQmjfXtWJ_PZqqJO9TJ3D03XncTFgZtiIH3vbP7DYWO4AU6Jk4bNj3Ni7B9hGSY/gi2Q6Udo3TosxVhy9BU1pBP-103Mhxld/15)**

Every year, I see it firsthand:

Students walk in with doubts, with fears, with barely enough money to afford the flight.

They walk out with confidence, connection, and a new sense of calling.

I've seen them go home and start chapters. I've seen them run for office.

Many tell me -- even years later, that this one event changed everything.

# Launching the “Hell Cats”
---
| | The Hell Cats officially launched! Jo joined CNN to talk about the coalition - a group of four Democratic women veterans running to flip key House seats and build a new generation of service-driven leadership. Mendoza also responded to the news that the Administration is trying to intimidate Arizona Senator and military veteran Mark Kelly.
_“We took an oath to serve, to protect and defend the Constitution and its people, and that's exactly what [Mark Kelly] is doing. Unfortunately, you have an Administration that is clearly creating distractions instead of addressing issues that people really need addressed, like lowering the cost of groceries,”_**JoAnna said** _._

| |
# A Community Conversation in Casa Grande
---
| | Last month, Jo hosted a community conversation in Casa Grande focused on affordability. Alongside Congressman Jason Crow (D-CO), former U.S. Senator Jon Tester (D-MT), and End Citizens United President Tiffany Muller, Jo took questions on the urgent need to lower costs for families, create good-paying jobs, and how she’ll fight for Southern Arizonans in Congress.
_“Our communities deserve a representative who shows up, listens, and then brings their voices back to Washington. We don’t have that right now,”_**said Mendoza**. “ _Juan Ciscomani refuses to fight for Southern Arizonans. He takes orders from DC elites – to gut health care, to eliminate life-changing jobs, to protect reckless tariffs – and has forgotten who he’s supposed to work for: us. In Congress, I’ll always put Southern Arizonans first.”_

# A Town Hall with Senator Kelly
---
| | Last week, Jo joined Senator Mark Kelly and Tucson Mayor Regina Romero for a town hall on lowering Arizonans’ health care costs, protecting veterans, and holding Juan Ciscomani accountable. The town hall was attended by more than 350 concerned Arizonans who are fed up with Ciscomani’s broken promises, failed leadership, and deference to party bosses in Washington, D.C.
---
[|
---](https://joannamendoza.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a848c5089d2c16d92422d70c8&id=58c1e13ca8&e=fea3203902)
| | _“I am sick and tired of the betrayal and the lies,”_ **Jo said**. _“Time and again, Juan Ciscomani votes against the people he is supposed to represent. He said he’d protect health care, then voted for the largest cuts to Medicaid in history. He voted to let Affordable Care Act tax credits expire, then fled town during a government shutdown instead of working out a deal. Ciscomani has made clear his loyalty is to party leadership, not to Arizonans.”_
_“I took an oath to protect and defend this country. I’m running for Congress because Arizonans deserve a leader who works for them – not for a political party or a president. I’ll fight to lower costs, protect our health care, and will always put Arizonans first.”_

https://kellyforcongress.org [https://kellyforcongress.org]
Hi Peter,
I wanted to reach out today to discuss something that I am often asked about: my thoughts on RFK Jr.
Since the moment the Trump Administration nominated RFK, Jr. to be in charge of the Department of Health and Human Services, my colleagues in the Democratic Doctors Caucus and I have been ringing the alarm. Earlier this fall, we called for his resignation.
Peter, RFK, Jr. is uniquely unqualified for this role. He has never run a large organization, he has no medical or scientific background, and he has peddled in and profited off of spreading conspiracy theories and dangerous misinformation about vaccines, reproductive healthcare, and mental healthcare for years.
Less than a year after his confirmation, our worst fears are being realized—RFK Jr. is actively dismantling decades of scientific progress. Progress that has delivered medical miracles, saved lives, and prevented diseases.
Peter, as a member of Congress, I am alarmed. As a physician, I am heartbroken. The policies this administration has enacted are weakening our formerly esteemed public health agencies, harming our global leadership in scientific and medical research, and making Americans sicker and less safe.
Today, I am more determined than ever to defend science. The American people are showing they want that too. This November, more than 100 leaders with STEM backgrounds were elected to local offices across the country. Voters are rejecting RFK Jr.’s dangerous agenda, and when we win the majority in the House in 2026, we can begin to provide some checks on this runaway administration and protect public health.
I am going to do everything I can to win re-election and to support Democrats in targeted House races because we must flip the U.S. House in 2026 .

The mad passions of a hunted animal stirred within him, and he loathed the man who was seated at the table, more than in his whole life he had ever loathed anything. He glanced wildly around. Something glimmered on the top of the painted chest that faced him. His eye fell on it. He knew what it was. It was a knife that he had brought up, some days before, to cut a piece of cord, and had forgotten to take away with him. He moved slowly towards it, passing Hallward as he did so. As soon as he got behind him, he seized it and turned round. Hallward stirred in his chair as if he was going to rise. He rushed at him and dug the knife into the great vein that is behind the ear, crushing the man’s head down on the table and stabbing again and again. There was a stifled groan and the horrible sound of some one choking with blood. Three times the outstretched arms shot up convulsively, waving grotesque, stiff-fingered hands in the air. He stabbed him twice more, but the man did not move. Something began to trickle on the floor. He waited for a moment, still pressing the head down. Then he threw the knife on the table, and listened. He could hear nothing, but the drip, drip on the threadbare carpet. He opened the door and went out on the landing. The house was absolutely quiet. No one was about. For a few seconds he stood bending over the balustrade and peering down into the black seething well of darkness. Then he took out the key and returned to the room, locking himself in as he did so. The thing was still seated in the chair, straining over the table with bowed head, and humped back, and long fantastic arms. Had it not been for the red jagged tear in the neck and the clotted black pool that was slowly widening on the table, one would have said that the man was simply asleep. How quickly it had all been done! He felt strangely calm, and walking over to the window, opened it and stepped out on the balcony. The wind had blown the fog away, and the sky was like a monstrous peacock’s tail, starred with myriads of golden eyes. He looked down and saw the policeman going his rounds and flashing the long beam of his lantern on the doors of the silent houses. The crimson spot of a prowling hansom gleamed at the corner and then vanished. A woman in a fluttering shawl was creeping slowly by the railings, staggering as she went. Now and then she stopped and peered back. Once, she began to sing in a hoarse voice. The policeman strolled over and said something to her. She stumbled away, laughing. A bitter blast swept across the square. The gas-lamps flickered and became blue, and the leafless trees shook their black iron branches to and fro. He shivered and went back, closing the window behind him.

Ivan Dmytrovych Sirko was born in the early seventeenth century, approximately between 1605 and 1610. This is evidenced primarily by the results of research on Sirko's remains, according to which the Cossack ataman was 70-75 years old at the time of his death in 1680. The first researcher of Sirko's biography, the famous Ukrainian historian Dmytro Yavornytskyi, suggested that the future ataman was born in Sloboda Ukraine in the settlement of Merefa (now the city of Merefa, Kharkiv region). However, this is not true. Merefa was founded only in 1658, i.e. when Sirko was in his late teens. However, Sirko and his family lived in Merefa for a long time in his house, and after his death, his wife and some family members lived there. The fact that Merefa in Slobozhanshchyna is associated with the name of the Cossack Ataman is evidenced by another name for the town recorded in some Ukrainian chronicles, Sirkivka. Where, then, should we look for Sirko's homeland? In our opinion, the sources give grounds to localize it in Eastern Podillia, namely in the Vinnytsia region. It is worth recalling that Sirko was a colonel in Vinnytsia (Kalnytsia) in 1658-1660. As you know, at that time in Ukraine, people who came from the local area were usually elected to such positions. Let us also recall a letter from Hetman of the Left Bank Ukraine Ivan Samoilovych to the tsarist voivode Prince G. Romodanovsky of April 20, 1675*, which recounts (in Russian) Sirko's own words: "And since I was born among the Poles, I want to die there." Thus, it is clear that Sirko was born on the Ukrainian lands that were under the rule of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, not Muscovy (the latter included Slobozhanshchyna). The historian Volodymyr Borysenko's assumption that Sirko's birthplace was the hundred-man town of the Bratslav regiment Murafa, a few kilometers from Kalnyk, is correct. Now it is the village of Zhdanov, Vinnytsia region. body:
Kansas case and new immigration report deepen scrutiny of Colorado’s stance on SAVE
| | | | [](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**
| | Hi friends,
**🎙️ Big News for the Mountain Minute Podcast!** We’re thrilled to share that in its very first year, the Mountain Minute podcast brought home _three_ Spotify awards:
💥 A 2025 Marathon Show, a 2025 Instant Hit Show, and a 2025 Most Shared Show!

If you haven’t tuned in yet, the Mountain Minute podcast is our quick 3–5 minute daily rundown of the top stories in Colorado and across the nation — perfect for anyone who prefers to listen to their news rather than read it. You can subscribe and listen anytime on [Spotify](https://link.email.joinrmv.), [YouTube](https://link.email.joinrmv.), or [Rumble](https://link.email.joinrmv.). Highly recommend giving it a try — it’s the fastest, sharpest way to stay informed every day.
**Listen to today's Mountain Minute podcast** [here](https://link.email.joinrmv.), or watch on [YouTube](https://link.email.joinrmv.) or [Rumble](https://link.email.joinrmv.). Here is a summary of today's top stories:
🏔️ **Here in Colorado...** Election-integrity concerns resurfaced after a Kansas noncitizen voting case spotlighted [Colorado’s refusal to use the federal SAVE system](https://link.email.joinrmv.). Douglas County advanced a [crackdown on retail theft](https://link.email.joinrmv.) by fining businesses that don’t report shoplifting, while Aurora [seized over 1,200 illegal vehicles](https://link.email.joinrmv.) under its three-strike rule. And the DOJ opened a sweeping investigation into Colorado’s prisons and youth facilities over [alleged constitutional violations](https://link.email.joinrmv.), including housing biological males in women’s prisons and providing inadequate medical care.
🇺🇸**On the National Stage...** The suicide of 15-year-old Bryce Tate put national focus on the [exploding teen sextortion crisis](https://link.email.joinrmv.), with federal officials warning of rising suicides tied to online predators. Meanwhile, Texas Rep. Brandon Gill warned of “judicial tyranny,” arguing [activist judges are obstructing President Trump’s agenda](https://link.email.joinrmv.) and overruling voters.
🗣️**Commentary Spotlight...** Commentary warns Colorado’s push to [phase out natural gas](https://link.email.joinrmv.) threatens family farms and food affordability, critiques how [communists distorted the meaning of “capitalism,”](https://link.email.joinrmv.) highlights a progressive tax plan that would [end the flat tax and weaken TABOR](https://link.email.joinrmv.), and blasts the PUC for [delaying public comment](https://link.email.joinrmv.) on its natural-gas ruling until January 14.
This is the Mountain Minute for Thursday, December 11, 2025.
– Team RMV
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[Kansas case and new immigration report deepen scrutiny of Colorado’s stance on SAVE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)** BY JEN SCHUMANN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
[](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
A Kansas mayor’s felony voting case is renewing national attention on how noncitizens end up registered to vote and what states can do to prevent it. The issue is gaining urgency as federal agencies expand the Systematic Alien Verification for Entitlements program, known as SAVE, while Colorado and several other states reject federal data-sharing efforts even as federal law requires them to maintain accurate voter rolls.
The case driving the discussion is unfolding in Coldwater, Kansas, where Mayor Jose “Joe” Ceballos-Armendariz, a noncitizen, has been charged with voting in at least three elections.
The state’s case rests on Kansas election statutes that classify noncitizen voting as a felony, exposing anyone convicted to heavy fines and potential incarceration. Prosecutors allege that Ceballos-Armendariz completed a routine voter registration form, then participated in federal and local contests.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**
|
---
**[Colorado’s Agricultural Economy Depends on Affordable, Reliable Energy](https://link.email.joinrmv.)** BY MATTHEW GONZALES, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
* **Colorado agriculture relies on affordable, reliable natural gas:** With 195,000 jobs and $47 billion in annual output, the state’s farm economy depends on natural gas to power irrigation, heat greenhouses, dry grain, and run food-storage operations—cost increases hit every family at the grocery store.
* **Energy-mandate politics threaten rural and Hispanic communities:** Calls to phase out natural gas ignore real-world consequences for working families, especially Hispanic agricultural communities who depend on lower energy costs to stay afloat. Electricity-only households already pay nearly double what natural-gas households do.
* **Natural gas is part of the solution—not the problem:** It generates 41% of Colorado’s electricity, has driven major U.S. emissions reductions, and gives family farms the stability they need to survive. Forcing a premature transition risks shutting down small operations and destabilizing the state’s food supply.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**
|

The only way we can continue to spread truth is with your support!
[DONATE TO ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
|
---
**[Colorado Progressive Tax Plan Advances Seeking End to Flat Tax and TABOR Limits](https://link.email.joinrmv.)** [COMPLETE COLORADO](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
* **Progressive activists push to end Colorado’s flat tax:** The proposal replaces the state’s simple, pro-growth flat tax with a steep progressive income-tax system, amounting to a $4.1 billion tax hike that would punish earners, shrink take-home pay, and expand government control over Colorado’s economy.
* **The initiative is backed by long-time opponents of TABOR refunds:** Led by the Bell Policy Center and former Rep. Chris deGruy Kennedy, the campaign aims to roll back voter-approved tax relief and redirect billions more into state coffers—marking a coordinated effort to grow government at taxpayers’ expense.
* **Early drafts sought to gut TABOR altogether:** The measure initially attempted to let the state permanently keep all revenue above the TABOR cap and end the ban on surcharges—an unmistakable attempt to dismantle Colorado’s strongest taxpayer protections and weaken constitutional limits on government power.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**
|
---
**ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️ **
[**A Town on Edge: Inside the Erie Mail Threats That Resulted in No Charges**](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
**BY SHAINA COLE | LOCAL | DECEMBER 9** _In early October, residents across Erie and in Virginia, began opening their mailboxes to find sympathy cards inside plain envelopes. The message referenced the assassination of Charlie Kirk, accompanied by an empty packet of Gushers candy taped to the card, glitter and a loose powdery substance that spilled when handled. Twenty residents in total received the cards. Many were former candidates, business owners, volunteers, and known conservatives within the community._
__
[**Probation for preaching: Scarboro challenges Regis with an open letter after disciplinary ruling**](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
**BY JEN SCHUMANN | LOCAL | DECEMBER 9** _When questions arose in September about a nursing student sharing the gospel on campus they first appeared as the kind of concerns that faith-based universities often try to settle quietly. Ministry staff raised concerns about tone. Security asked clarifying questions. Meetings happened behind closed doors. For a time the matter seemed headed toward quiet resolution._
__
[**Secretary Griswold’s Reckless Assault on Election Integrity**](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
[****](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**BY MICHAEL J BADAGLIACCO "MJB" | COMMENTARY | DECEMBER 9** _Colorado Secretary of State Jena Griswold’s recent statement rejecting the U.S. Department of Justice’s request for voter registration data is not just misguided; it is a blatant act of partisan obstruction that undermines the very foundation of the American Republic._

# **Bessent leads the charge to reform Obama era financial oversight council**
Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent is **[poised to upend](https://substack.com/redirect/c9343383-1fd1-4344-b90c-a301999fc28d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** the Financial Stability Oversight Council, proposing a dramatic pivot from 2008 crisis-era crackdowns to deregulation that could unleash economic growth in a letter unveiled Thursday.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c9343383-1fd1-4344-b90c-a301999fc28d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Bessent Chairs Deregulation Drive** : As FSOC head, Bessent's letter urges members to probe if U.S. rules stifle growth and erode stability, flipping the council's traditional enforcement role.
* **Post-Crisis Body Targeted** : Established in 2010 amid 2008 meltdown fallout, FSOC monitored Wall Street risks to avert repeats; now, it faces scrutiny for overreach and stifling economic growth.
* **AI Resilience Task Force** : The proposal launches a working group to harness AI for bolstering financial durability while also scanning emerging tech for unforeseen hazards.
* **Trump Agenda Alignment** : The initiative echoes the Trump administration's pro-business rollback, diverging sharply from prior emphasis on intensified oversight of big banks under Presidents Obama and Biden.

# **Ifrah Law heightens the success of iGaming clients through every phase of their business cycle**
Led by a managing partner who has been **[at the center of every significant court case affecting online gaming,](https://substack.com/redirect/f42485a8-f489-4175-98ac-e11491ec204c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** Ifrah Law operates at the cutting edge of technology, innovation, and regulation.
Its lawyers represent industry players throughout the entire business cycle, from the formation of a corporation or licensing relationship, through marketing, partnering, growth, and disputes, to profitable exits.
We're proud to share that all partners at Ifrah Law have been ranked by Chambers and Partners, the gold standard for evaluating legal excellence worldwide.

# **Oracle 's debt load crushes earnings, shares tank as AI panic spreads**
Oracle shares **[cratered 15% Thursday](https://substack.com/redirect/a8331e0d-7a65-42ef-bcb8-a0ce03b00c73?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** after earnings revealed a $16.06 billion revenue shortfall and $10 billion negative free cash flow, igniting fears over massive AI infrastructure debt and rippling panic through Nvidia, AMD, and CoreWeave stocks amid a volatile Silicon Valley sell-off.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/a8331e0d-7a65-42ef-bcb8-a0ce03b00c73?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Concerning Trend Continues:** Including the 15% crash yesterday Oracle's share price has now fallen by more than 41% in the last three months. From a high of $330 on September 11th to as low as $186 today.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/a8331e0d-7a65-42ef-bcb8-a0ce03b00c73?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Earnings Miss Sparks Turmoil** : Oracle's Q2 revenue hit $16.06 billion, undercutting $16.21 billion forecasts, as aggressive AI data center expansions fueled investor doubts on sustainability.
* **Debt Avalanche Alarms Wall Street** : The company plans $20-30 billion in annual borrowing through 2028, including a record $18 billion September bond sale, alongside a $50 billion fiscal 2025 capex surge.
* **Sector-Wide Sell-Off Ensues** : Nvidia dropped over 2%, AMD 3%, CoreWeave 5%, and Micron 1%, amplifying scrutiny on AI bubble debt risks despite robust demand signals.
* **Analysts Spot Buying Chance** : Wedbush calls the dip a "clear opportunity," citing healthy AI backlog; as Oracle eyes chip leasing and customer-supplied hardware to ease debt pressures.

* * *
* * *
# **Fed cuts again but warns that the pace of cuts may slow down**
In a divided 10-3 vote, the Federal Reserve **[cut its benchmark interest rate](https://substack.com/redirect/ebc4cffd-a4df-401b-aa52-7358f9dcece0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** by a quarter-point Wednesday marking the third reduction this year amid cooling inflation, but signaled a cautious slowdown with just one more cut eyed for 2026.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ebc4cffd-a4df-401b-aa52-7358f9dcece0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Third Consecutive Cut Approved** : The Federal Open Market Committee lowers federal funds rate to 3.5%-3.75% on December 10, 2025, in a split decision with three dissents for deeper or no action.
* **Internal Divisions Exposed** : Dissenters include Governor Stephen Miran pushing for half-point slash and regional presidents favoring pause, highlighting policy rifts amid funding market pressures.
* **Projections Signal Restraint** : The Fed's "Dot Plot" forecasts a single 2026 rate cut and one in 2027, with GDP growth upgraded to 2.3% but inflation lingering above 2% target until 2028.
* **Markets Rally Cautiously** : Stocks surged with Dow gaining 500 points post-announcement, while Treasury yields dip. The Fed will also resume $40 billion Treasury bill buys to ease liquidity strains.

* * *
* * *
# **Pepsi to axe hundreds of snacks and slashes prices after investor pressure**
In a bold capitulation to activist investor Elliott Management's pressure - after they took a $4 billion stake, PepsiCo announced Tuesday it will slash nearly **[20% of its U.S. product lineup](https://substack.com/redirect/76e974fb-6df8-4ffd-aaf9-109fe2ed6528?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** --hundreds of snack and beverage SKUs--by early 2026 while closing plants and cutting prices to revive lagging sales against rival Coca-Cola.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/76e974fb-6df8-4ffd-aaf9-109fe2ed6528?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Activist Stake Ignites Overhaul** : Elliott's September $4 billion investment prompted a scathing letter demanding cost cuts, outsourcing of bottling, and divestitures to counter PepsiCo's decade-low valuations and sales slump.
* **Factories Shuttered for Savings** : Three U.S. plants face closure and select production lines face cancellation in 2025, targeting productivity gains and at least a 1% annual profit margin boosts over three years.
* **Healthier Launches Prioritized** : New products emphasizing no artificial colors, higher protein, fiber, and whole grains aim to align with consumer trends, boosting mainstream brand frequency amid affordability drives.
* **Growth Rebound Forecasted** : Executives project 2-4% core sales acceleration in late 2026, fueled by streamlined operations and reinvested capital, with Elliott praising the "urgent" collaborative pivot.

* * *
* * *
# **Cracker Barrel 's Woke hangover is going to take a long time to recover from**
Cracker Barrel's reckless rebrand, meant to modernize its folksy image which instead sparked a nationwide backlash and forced a hasty reversal, is still haunting the company, with CEO Julie Masino warning Tuesday that the **[chain's recovery from plunging sales and traffic](https://substack.com/redirect/722d4413-f58c-4555-bb8d-11895acd1639?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** will demand patience amid lingering consumer distrust.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/722d4413-f58c-4555-bb8d-11895acd1639?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Sales Plunge Drastically** : First-quarter revenue dropped 5.7% year-over-year, with traffic declining 1% early August and 9% later from the botched overhaul, is exacerbating financial strain
* **EBITDA Takes Major Hit** : Adjusted earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization fell to $7.2 million from $45.8 million last year, partly due to $14 million in unexpected marketing and conference costs.
* **CEO Voices Deep Remorse** : Masino admitted the rebrand "missed the mark" on guest comfort goals, and to feeling "fired by America" over the uproar, while vowing to rebuild trust through targeted apologies.
* **Strategic Shifts Accelerate** : The company now prioritizes menu tweaks, back-of-house efficiencies, and leadership changes to cut costs and stabilize operations, aiming for fiscal 2025 trajectory despite macro challenges.

| | Dorian Gray glanced at the picture, and suddenly an uncontrollable feeling of hatred for Basil Hallward came over him, as though it had been suggested to him by the image on the canvas, whispered into his ear by those grinning lips. The mad passions of a hunted animal stirred within him, and he loathed the man who was seated at the table, more than in his whole life he had ever loathed anything. He glanced wildly around. Something glimmered on the top of the painted chest that faced him. His eye fell on it. He knew what it was. It was a knife that he had brought up, some days before, to cut a piece of cord, and had forgotten to take away with him. He moved slowly towards it, passing Hallward as he did so. As soon as he got behind him, he seized it and turned round. Hallward stirred in his chair as if he was going to rise. He rushed at him and dug the knife into the great vein that is behind the ear, crushing the man’s head down on the table and stabbing again and again. There was a stifled groan and the horrible sound of some one choking with blood. Three times the outstretched arms shot up convulsively, waving grotesque, stiff-fingered hands in the air. He stabbed him twice more, but the man did not move. Something began to trickle on the floor. He waited for a moment, still pressing the head down. Then he threw the knife on the table, and listened. He could hear nothing, but the drip, drip on the threadbare carpet. He opened the door and went out on the landing. The house was absolutely quiet. No one was about. For a few seconds he stood bending over the balustrade and peering down into the black seething well of darkness. Then he took out the key and returned to the room, locking himself in as he did so. The thing was still seated in the chair, straining over the table with bowed head, and humped back, and long fantastic arms. Had it not been for the red jagged tear in the neck and the clotted black pool that was slowly widening on the table, one would have said that the man was simply asleep. How quickly it had all been done! He felt strangely calm, and walking over to the window, opened it and stepped out on the balcony. The wind had blown the fog away, and the sky was like a monstrous peacock’s tail, starred with myriads of golden eyes. He looked down and saw the policeman going his rounds and flashing the long beam of his lantern on the doors of the silent houses. The crimson spot of a prowling hansom gleamed at the corner and then vanished. A woman in a fluttering shawl was creeping slowly by the railings, staggering as she went. Now and then she stopped and peered back. Once, she began to sing in a hoarse voice. The policeman strolled over and said something to her. She stumbled away, laughing. A bitter blast swept across the square. The gas-lamps flickered and became blue, and the leafless trees shook their black iron branches to and fro. He shivered and went back, closing the window behind him.

Ivan Dmytrovych Sirko was born in the early seventeenth century, approximately between 1605 and 1610. This is evidenced primarily by the results of research on Sirko's remains, according to which the Cossack ataman was 70-75 years old at the time of his death in 1680. The first researcher of Sirko's biography, the famous Ukrainian historian Dmytro Yavornytskyi, suggested that the future ataman was born in Sloboda Ukraine in the settlement of Merefa (now the city of Merefa, Kharkiv region). However, this is not true. Merefa was founded only in 1658, i.e. when Sirko was in his late teens. However, Sirko and his family lived in Merefa for a long time in his house, and after his death, his wife and some family members lived there. The fact that Merefa in Slobozhanshchyna is associated with the name of the Cossack Ataman is evidenced by another name for the town recorded in some Ukrainian chronicles, Sirkivka. Where, then, should we look for Sirko's homeland? In our opinion, the sources give grounds to localize it in Eastern Podillia, namely in the Vinnytsia region. It is worth recalling that Sirko was a colonel in Vinnytsia (Kalnytsia) in 1658-1660. As you know, at that time in Ukraine, people who came from the local area were usually elected to such positions. Let us also recall a letter from Hetman of the Left Bank Ukraine Ivan Samoilovych to the tsarist voivode Prince G. Romodanovsky of April 20, 1675*, which recounts (in Russian) Sirko's own words: "And since I was born among the Poles, I want to die there." Thus, it is clear that Sirko was born on the Ukrainian lands that were under the rule of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, not Muscovy (the latter included Slobozhanshchyna). The historian Volodymyr Borysenko's assumption that Sirko's birthplace was the hundred-man town of the Bratslav regiment Murafa, a few kilometers from Kalnyk, is correct. Now it is the village of Zhdanov, Vinnytsia region. By the way, Murafa in the Slobozhanshchyna probably originated from this Murafa, because immigrants from the Right Bank of Ukraine to the Left Bank often gave the newly founded settlements the names of their native villages or towns. It is also worth noting Sirko's great interest in Keleberda, which he founded in 1675 on the left bank of the Dnipro. For a long time, he sought from the Moscow tsar the right to own this town or sloboda, as well as the strategically important crossing of the Dnipro near Perevolochna (Sirko wanted this crossing not for himself, but for the entire Zaporozhian Lowland Army). Contrary to popular belief, we believe that Sirko did not come from a Cossack family, but from a small Ukrainian Orthodox gentry. For example, we know the name of a Podillia nobleman, Voytekh Sirko, who was married to a certain Olena Kozynska. Sources mention them in 1592. It is possible that they were relatives of the Cossack leader. Perhaps it is no coincidence that the kings of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, writing to Sirko, called him "urodzon." The word "nobleman" evokes negative associations for many people due to stereotypes instilled in school textbooks of the Stalinist era. However, this approach is not always correct. The term "nobleman" is identical to the words "knight," "chevalier," "nobleman," etc. and was commonly used not only in Poland but also in Ukraine, Belarus, and the Czech Republic. If scholars in Russia, Poland, and the Czech Republic, having contracted vulgar sociologism, no longer accuse Pushkin or Bunin, Suvorov or Kutuzov, Žižka or Kostiushko of being of noble or gentry origin, why have attacks on the Ukrainian and Belarusian gentry continued until recently? Is it not because in this way the imperial "divide and conquer" was transferred to our long-suffering history? Was it not because it was necessary to impose a nihilistic attitude toward the history of Ukraine, to "prove" that Ukrainians or Belarusians were just dark labor without national consciousness, ethnographic material doomed to build other people's empires? Meanwhile, the Ukrainian gentry produced many outstanding sons of Ukraine, fighters for its freedom. Suffice it to mention the names of Kryshtof Kosinski, Petro Konashevych-Sahaidachny, Ivan Sulyma, Ivan Mazepa, Bohdan Khmelnytsky, and his associates: Ivan and Danylo Vyhovsky, Ivan Bohun, Danylo and Ivan Nechai, Mykhailo Krychevsky, Jan Sokolovsky, Siluyan Muzhylovsky, and others. Sirko's appearance and personality do not always coincide with the conventional ideas about him that have developed in some works of art. The Cossack leader was slightly taller than average (174-176 cm), had regular facial features, and a straight nose. By the way, the great Relin intuitively caught this when he depicted him in the center of his painting "Cossacks Writing a Letter to the Turkish Sultan." It is interesting that the prototype for Sirko's image in the painting was the famous military leader General Dragomirov. Only one significant detail was not known to Repin and his consultant D. Yavornytskyi - a red birthmark on Sirko's lower lip on the right side. His contemporaries considered it a "sign of God" given to distinguish him from ordinary people. The Grand Hetman of the Crown, the future King of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, Jan Sobieski, who knew Sirko well and met him in Bratslav in 1671.

Weiss, PhD Weiss Ratings Founder Ivan Dmytrovych Sirko was born in the early seventeenth century, approximately between 1605 and 1610. This is evidenced primarily by the results of research on Sirko's remains, according to which the Cossack ataman was 70-75 years old at the time of his death in 1680. The first researcher of Sirko's biography, the famous Ukrainian historian Dmytro Yavornytskyi, suggested that the future ataman was born in Sloboda Ukraine in the settlement of Merefa (now the city of Merefa, Kharkiv region). However, this is not true. Merefa was founded only in 1658, i.e. when Sirko was in his late teens. However, Sirko and his family lived in Merefa for a long time in his house, and after his death, his wife and some family members lived there. The fact that Merefa in Slobozhanshchyna is associated with the name of the Cossack Ataman is evidenced by another name for the town recorded in some Ukrainian chronicles, Sirkivka. Where, then, should we look for Sirko's homeland? In our opinion, the sources give grounds to localize it in Eastern Podillia, namely in the Vinnytsia region. It is worth recalling that Sirko was a colonel in Vinnytsia (Kalnytsia) in 1658-1660. As you know, at that time in Ukraine, people who came from the local area were usually elected to such positions. Let us also recall a letter from Hetman of the Left Bank Ukraine Ivan Samoilovych to the tsarist voivode Prince G. Romodanovsky of April 20, 1675*, which recounts (in Russian) Sirko's own words: "And since I was born among the Poles, I want to die there." Thus, it is clear that Sirko was born on the Ukrainian lands that were under the rule of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, not Muscovy (the latter included Slobozhanshchyna). The historian Volodymyr Borysenko's assumption that Sirko's birthplace was the hundred-man town of the Bratslav regiment Murafa, a few kilometers from Kalnyk, is correct. Now it is the village of Zhdanov, Vinnytsia region. By the way, Murafa in the Slobozhanshchyna probably originated from this Murafa, because immigrants from the Right Bank of Ukraine to the Left Bank often gave the newly founded settlements the names of their native villages or towns. It is also worth noting Sirko's great interest in Keleberda, which he founded in 1675 on the left bank of the Dnipro. For a long time, he sought from the Moscow tsar the right to own this town or sloboda, as well as the strategically important crossing of the Dnipro near Perevolochna (Sirko wanted this crossing not for himself, but for the entire Zaporozhian Lowland Army). Contrary to popular belief, we believe that Sirko did not come from a Cossack family, but from a small Ukrainian Orthodox gentry. For example, we know the name of a Podillia nobleman, Voytekh Sirko, who was married to a certain Olena Kozynska. Sources mention them in 1592. It is possible that they were relatives of the Cossack leader. Perhaps it is no coincidence that the kings of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, writing to Sirko, called him "urodzon." The word "nobleman" evokes negative associations for many people due to stereotypes instilled in school textbooks of the Stalinist era. However, this approach is not always correct. The term "nobleman" is identical to the words "knight," "chevalier," "nobleman," etc. and was commonly used not only in Poland but also in Ukraine, Belarus, and the Czech Republic. If scholars in Russia, Poland, and the Czech Republic, having contracted vulgar sociologism, no longer accuse Pushkin or Bunin, Suvorov or Kutuzov, Žižka or Kostiushko of being of noble or gentry origin, why have attacks on the Ukrainian and Belarusian gentry continued until recently? Is it not because in this way the imperial "divide and conquer" was transferred to our long-suffering history? Was it not because it was necessary to impose a nihilistic attitude toward the history of Ukraine, to "prove" that Ukrainians or Belarusians were just dark labor without national consciousness, ethnographic material doomed to build other people's empires? Meanwhile, the Ukrainian gentry produced many outstanding sons of Ukraine, fighters for its freedom. Suffice it to mention the names of Kryshtof Kosinski, Petro Konashevych-Sahaidachny, Ivan Sulyma, Ivan Mazepa, Bohdan Khmelnytsky, and his associates: Ivan and Danylo Vyhovsky, Ivan Bohun, Danylo and Ivan Nechai, Mykhailo Krychevsky, Jan Sokolovsky, Siluyan Muzhylovsky, and others. Sirko's appearance and personality do not always coincide with the conventional ideas about him that have developed in some works of art. The Cossack leader was slightly taller than average (174-176 cm), had regular facial features, and a straight nose. By the way, the great Relin intuitively caught this when he depicted him in the center of his painting "Cossacks Writing a Letter to the Turkish Sultan." It is interesting that the prototype for Sirko's image in the painting was the famous military leader General Dragomirov. Only one significant detail was not known to Repin and his consultant D. Yavornytskyi - a red birthmark on Sirko's lower lip on the right side. His contemporaries considered it a "sign of God" given to distinguish him from ordinary people. He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18] | | | | | | I’m looking to cut a deal with you. Peter,

At the end of this month, health insurance premiums are set to rise astronomically -- doubling, tripling, or even quadrupling in price. Tens of thousands of people in CA-27 will be affected.

Right now, I want to break down exactly what these “premium tax credits” are and how the clock is ticking on affordability for millions of Americans:

The term “premium tax credit” is the official name of the Affordable Care Act subsidy that lowers monthly insurance premiums. This credit acts like a coupon for those receiving healthcare through the ACA -- reducing the cost.
Keeping premiums low is essential to making sure hardworking Americans can afford their health insurance. Now, these subsidies are set to expire at the end of the year -- and Republicans are refusing to extend them or even offer an alternative. That’s why Democrats held the line during the GOP shutdown, and it’s why we must win back the House next year to protect healthcare.

I’m doing everything I can in Congress to ensure healthcare stays affordable -- especially when costs are already rising dramatically for working families.

If you’re with me and feel compelled to donate, $3 or any amount will help me stay in the fight as we inch closer to the all-important midterm election year.

**➤➤ BREAKING: Trump case at SCOTUS could destroy independent watchdogs** [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/121087203/588313779/-248329304?refcode=em-12.11.25-all-rs&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS84OTkxNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhMmQ2OWQ5ZC1jNWQ2LWYwMTEtODE5NS0wMDBkM2ExZDU4YWEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=0t2Q-ujrddemo00AArcAgTuhoSDmlTLnUI94_5JmU9M=) Friend, Donald Trump’s assault on democracy isn’t just about elections anymore. Now he’s targeting the agencies that hold him accountable. **The Trump administration is asking the Supreme Court to eliminate the very concept of independent federal agencies** , starting with the FTC, but the consequences could ripple out to the FEC, FCC, and more. In short: If Trump wins this case,**future presidents could fire any official who stands in their way,** and agencies meant to protect consumers, regulate elections, or police corruption would become extensions of executive power. And we’ve made tremendous progress.

Now, the field changes and the race gets more expensive with Congresswoman Jasmine Crockett’s announcement that she’s entering the Democratic primary.

We’ve built this movement on unity over division, and it is with that spirit that we welcome Congresswoman Crockett into this race.

You are warmly invited to join us for the County’s TreeLighting celebration at our new building, 500 County Center, held in partnership with the Service League. This marks our first tree lighting at this location, and we are excited to begin this new tradition with you. The celebration will take place on Thursday, December 11, 2025, from 4:00 PM to 5:30 PM in the first-floor lobby of 500 County Center. We’re also pleased to share that the Aragon High School Chorus will join us with live music to help kick off the season. As part of the event, **we encourage you to bring a new, unwrapped gift to support the Service League Toy Drive**. Your generosity will help brighten the holiday season for children and families in our community. Light refreshments will be available, and we hope this gathering offers a moment to connect, celebrate, and enjoy the spirit of the season together. We look forward to seeing you there.
In Friendship,

David Canepa
San Mateo County Board President

name: Deb Haaland
subject: This is who I am
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY DEB FOR NEW MEXICO**
body:
Getting here wasn't easy, Friend
| | | [](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/134?t=1&akid=6146%2E400544%2EN5QG_h)
---
Friend: In a moment, **[I'm going to ask you to make a $5 donation to my campaign.](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/1699?t=2&akid=6146%2E400544%2EN5QG_h)** But first, will you let me explain who I am, why I'm in this race, and the difference your donation will make?
As the daughter of a Pueblo woman, I was taught the value of hard work from a very young age.

My mother was born and raised in a train boxcar, where the Laguna people built a community far from their home. She proudly served in the U.S. Navy, raised four kids as a military wife, and devoted more than two decades to Indian education at the Bureau of Indian Affairs.

I am blessed to come from generations of resilient and fierce Pueblo women – **and I am the person, mother, and leader I am today because of them.**
[](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/1695?t=3&akid=6146%2E400544%2EN5QG_h)
**But getting here wasn't easy, friend, and the hard work and resilience I learned proved essential.
**
Like many New Mexicans, I know what it’s like to struggle. I was a single mom living paycheck to paycheck, relying on government programs like SNAP, WIC, and Medicaid to help keep my child fed and healthy. **Every day, as hard as it was, I had to get back up and keep going.
**
But my struggle made me fierce. It fortified my resolve to build a brighter future – not only for my child, _but for every family dreaming of and fighting for a better life._

That's why I decided to run for office in 2018. _And I won._ I became one of the first Native American women elected to Congress, and in 2021, the first Native American cabinet secretary in U.S. history.
**
Now, I'm running to be the next governor of New Mexico to help move our state toward a future where everyone can thrive.**
**Every step of my journey has been possible because people like you believed in me,****friend****. So please:**[**Can I count on you to chip in $5 or more right now to help me win, keep New Mexico blue and deliver progress for working families?**](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/1700?amount=5&t=4&akid=6146%2E400544%2EN5QG_h)
_If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | | | [Donate $10](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/1701?t=5&akid=6146%2E400544%2EN5QG_h)
---
| | [Donate $35](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/1702?t=6&akid=6146%2E400544%2EN5QG_h)
---
| | [Donate $50](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/1703?t=7&akid=6146%2E400544%2EN5QG_h)
---
| | [Other Amount](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/1704?t=8&akid=6146%2E400544%2EN5QG_h)
---
I know that it takes a village – in life, and in politics – and that's why I'll never stop fighting for our communities.

Thank you for standing with me,

Deb
|

The fight for working people didn’t end when the polls closed last month — it just entered its next chapter. | | | Peter,
